niche: a listed UK solar fund choosing which of four 11 MWp candidates it builds in 2027, sized by first-full-year export on the 2016 to 2025 weather, when the sunniest candidate's planned inverter blocks wrap a broiler unit's yard and the fleet records such a unit's dust only in the SCADA of the three blocks of a large western farm nearest its sheds
answer_source: submission.md block 1; generator/figures.json call_site and call_export_mwh
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file correctly takes Knowle Park's measured performance at the fiscal meter, checks dry-day soiling and the environs at farm level, finds nothing and builds Hallam Down at about 10,100 MWh; Wexcombe's meter runs 1.1 per cent above its 2012 to 2014 peers, but its SCADA shows the three blocks nearest a 10-shed broiler unit (87 to 141 m) losing 1.5 to 4.2 per cent to a deposit that builds on dry days, washes off in rain and falls with distance from the sheds, and Hallam Down's ten planned blocks sit 76 to 269 m from a unit of the same size on about 520 mm of rain a year, so it loses at least 4.7 per cent (7.4 on the best fit) against a 4.1 per cent lead and Kingsley Fields wins at 9,700 MWh.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each candidate's first-year export, which PV performance engineering builds as plane-of-array irradiation times the fleet's measured performance ratio less a soiling loss, here a deposit whose daily rate falls with each inverter block's distance from a broiler unit, measured on the analog farm's block SCADA and washed off by the site's own rain above a threshold; swap in a hospital or a bus route and there is no array whose blocks soil by their distance from a source between showers.

fiscal meter export against inverter SCADA, apart by transformer and cable losses
an O&M log with partial-day availability at farm and inverter level

spine.entity: one inverter block's energy on one day

driver: A loss read at site level averages a deposit that falls off with distance from its source over the many units far from it, so no site in the record looks affected; the candidate's units all sit close to a similar source and its own weather clears the deposit less often, so its expected output is the resource less a loss several times any site-level figure on file, and the leader on the resource falls behind.
driver_concrete: Wexcombe's fiscal meter sums 58 central-inverter blocks and runs 1.1 per cent above its 2012 to 2014 peers, but the three blocks nearest a 10-shed broiler unit lose 1.5 to 4.2 per cent to litter dust that settles on dry days and washes off in rain; Hallam Down's ten planned blocks wrap the yard of a 10-shed unit at 76 to 269 m on about 520 mm of rain a year against Wexcombe's 1,500, so its 4.1 per cent irradiation lead over Kingsley Fields becomes a loss of 4.7 to 7.5 per cent across the deposit fits and it falls from 10,100 MWh to no more than 9,600, below Kingsley Fields' 9,700.
stump: A competent solver applies the fleet's measured performance to each candidate's average-year irradiation and builds Hallam Down at about 10,100 MWh, where the golden is Kingsley Fields at 9,700 MWh; the step that lands it there is reading the loss at the fiscal meter, where Wexcombe's three blocks nearest a broiler unit average away among its 58, when Hallam Down's ten planned blocks all sit 76 to 269 m from a unit of the same size on a record a third as wet.

differentiation.task72: task72 books a movement to the owner whose agreement covered each piece of a partitioned total; here nothing is booked or partitioned: a deposit is measured at the inverter-block grain, where it falls off with distance from its source, and carried to a candidate whose every block sits near a similar source.
differentiation.task181: task181 counts events from the crossings a period's traffic creates; here the decisive quantity is a soiling loss read at a sub-site grain, carried by distance from the source and simulated on the candidate's own rain record.
differentiation.task60: task60 groups and ranks a register of filings across filers; here the two grains are an export meter and its inverter blocks, both correct, and the step is reading a distance-decaying deposit off the blocks and carrying it to a candidate's planned layout.
